question_snapshot.stem_en: An organisation acting bona fide seeks enforcement of the rights of an exploited group unable to approach the court because of poverty and social disadvantage. The organisation has no personal financial loss. Which assessment best reflects PIL standing?
options_en: Absence of personal loss does not by itself defeat standing where genuine public interest and sufficient interest are shown.
Representative petitions are barred whenever the organisation itself has suffered no personal injury.
Only the individual victims may petition; a social organisation cannot represent them.
A public authority must first refer the dispute to court before a representative petition can be considered.
